'''Reeqo Swen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] Swen and another apprentice, [[Melari Ruxon]], assisted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her husband, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], in the detainment of the [[Force psychosis|insane]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]]. Shortly after, however, Swen and Ruxon decided to resign from the Order, as they were unhappy with the way Daala was beginning to take control of the Jedi.
